about: Part xymove's entries (docs/GAME.md 2.4 row xymove, 'Inputs and outputs'; docs/game-parts/xymove.md). P_XYMovement takes the mobj in upstream's _Dp[0-3] (natively A:X) and returns nothing its callers read (upstream's A = 0 of LEAVE); slideMove (P_SlideMove) takes it in AP (natively A:X) and returns nothing. Upstream's own scratch (MV_*, SL_*, HS_*) is the reference's near scratch (exclusion R2): what the move leaves is the mobj, the player and the lists, which the canonical state compares.
